prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1126; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Sugar Land, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the facts of what happened, if that's alright.

Q: That's fine, but I do need you to identify yourself for the file. Can you confirm your name?

A: Sure. It's the person listed as the driver on the policy paperwork.

Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were when the collision occurred?

A: I was backing out of a parking space in a large retail lot. It was late afternoon and the lot was pretty busy.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?

A: Not right away. I checked my mirrors and saw nothing, but then I heard a horn and felt the impact on the rear passenger side of my car.

Q: How fast were you moving when you started backing?

A: Very slowly, maybe walking pace. I was still turning the wheel when it happened.

Q: Were you injured in the collision?

A: Yes. My right knee hit the dashboard area when the car jolted. It swelled up within a few hours and I've had trouble bearing weight on it since.

Q: Have you received medical treatment for the knee?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same evening. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor. I have an appointment set up for later this week.

Q: Were there any witnesses you're aware of?

A: I'm not sure. A couple of people were walking nearby, but I didn't get their names.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your account?

A: Only that I've been careful about this from the start and I want the damage to my car and my knee dealt with properly.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
